metadata.name: Documenso
metadata.description: Documenso v2.19.0 is an open-source document signing platform backed by PostgreSQL.
metadata.author: BigBearTechWorld

environment_variables.name: PORT
environment_variables.description: Port Documenso listens on inside the container.

environment_variables.name: NEXT_PRIVATE_ENCRYPTION_KEY
environment_variables.description: Primary encryption key. At least 32 characters.

environment_variables.name: NEXT_PRIVATE_ENCRYPTION_SECONDARY_KEY
environment_variables.description: Secondary encryption key. At least 32 characters.

environment_variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBAPP_URL
environment_variables.description: Public URL where browsers reach Documenso.

environment_variables.name: NEXT_PRIVATE_INTERNAL_WEBAPP_URL
environment_variables.description: URL the app uses to call itself inside the container.

environment_variables.name: NEXT_PRIVATE_DATABASE_URL
environment_variables.description: PostgreSQL connection string. Must match the database service.

environment_variables.name: NEXT_PRIVATE_DIRECT_DATABASE_URL
environment_variables.description: Direct PostgreSQL connection string used for migrations.

environment_variables.name: NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_TRANSPORT
environment_variables.description: Email transport. smtp-auth is username and password SMTP.

environment_variables.name: NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_HOST
environment_variables.description: SMTP server hostname. Replace with a real server before sending mail.

environment_variables.name: NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_USERNAME
environment_variables.description: SMTP username. Replace with the real account.

environment_variables.name: NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_PASSWORD
environment_variables.description: SMTP password. Replace with the real account password.

environment_variables.name: POSTGRES_USER
environment_variables.description: PostgreSQL user for the documenso-db service.

environment_variables.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
environment_variables.description: PostgreSQL password. Must match the database URLs.

before_install.en_us: Open http://localhost:20030. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBAPP_URL to the URL people will use to reach this instance. Replace NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_HOST, NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_USERNAME, and NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_PASSWORD with a real mail server before sending email. The app starts without a signing certificate, but document signing fails until you add a PKCS#12 file and NEXT_PRIVATE_SIGNING_PASSPHRASE. See https://docs.documenso.com/docs/self-hosting/configuration/signing-certificate.
